summary: ArrayVec::capacity returned the backing array length even when it exceeded 65,535, the maximum length representable by its u16 length field. The fix caps reported capacity at u16::MAX. The exact implementation reversal is identifiable, but no detecting upstream test was found at the fixed commit: the fix adds no tests, and existing tests and fuzz targets use smaller backing arrays. Blocked pending an existing detecting upstream test; no builds or tests were run.
